seen_animation: A black-line tractor drawing (tall cab, low hood block, two looped wheels) sits in the centre of the frame between a grey tree line above and grey grass and bushes below. A horizontal boom runs out to both sides, and two square boxes hang under each end. Across frames 1-16 the tractor stays in place and rocks slightly: the body tilts a few degrees, the right boxes swing and tilt in frames 2-3 and 6-8, the left outer box swings out of square in frames 9-10 and 13, and the boxes settle level again in frames 14-16. No travel across the frame.
seen_film: A white pickup truck faces the camera in a tall-grass field in front of a dark tree line. A horizontal boom across its front carries yellow boxes on both sides. Across frames 1-16 the truck stays almost in the same place, bouncing slightly over rough ground; the boxes sway and tip, most clearly the left outer box tipping in frames 9-11 and 13, and the right boxes swinging in frames 2-3 and 6-8. The camera holds; there is no large movement.
named_subject: a tractor (standing in for the film's boom-carrying pickup truck) with boxes hanging from a side boom
evidence: Judged from still frames only, not playback. The film is a near-stationary vehicle bouncing with swinging boxes, and the animation matches that: g.png shows the drawings clustered on one spot with small rocking offsets and no gaps or reversals. In e.png the right boxes tilt around frames 21-24 while the film's right boxes swing in f.png 21-24; the left outer box tips in e.png 31-36 and 49-51 while the film's left box tips in f.png 31-40 and 49-52. Body tilt changes by a few degrees between consecutive frames with no size change, doubling or redraw. Frames 57-62 settle level in both.
primary_gap: The box swing in the animation is smaller and shorter than the film's, most visibly in f.png 33-40 where the film's left box stays tipped for about eight frames while e.png 37-40 already returns it nearly to square.
closes_when: In e.png 31-40 the left outer box stays visibly tipped (about 15-20 degrees off square, as in f.png) for the full span before returning level around frame 41.
protect: The doodle's construction and stroke habits for the cab, hood block and looped wheels; the tractor held in one place at the film's frame position; the small continuous rocking with no pops; the timing of the right-box swing (21-24) and left-box tips (31-36, 49-51) that line up with the film; the boom and boxes drawn in the same plain square line style.
identity_gap: The cab, hood and two looped wheels are the c.png drawing; the boom and four boxes are additions not in the doodle, but they are drawn in its plain straight-line style and do not change the core drawing.
